prog_cost_num, p.acct_num prog_acct_num, psc.psc_description service_description, psc.psc_code service_code, psc.psc_charge service_charge, sr.reviewer_signature, sr.reviewer_date, s.cancel_reason, trunc(s.date_session, 'month') date_session_month FROM clients c LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.case_number = c.case_number LEFT JOIN programs p ON c.p_id = p.p_id LEFT JOIN program_service_codes psc ON
